events.description: Chandler Bing says a coworker Chandler Bing is interested in is really, really cute.
Ross Geller says the fact that the coworker is cute does not matter.
Ross Geller says Chandler Bing should not get romantically involved with a coworker from Chandler Bing's company.
Monica Geller says Ross Geller's monkey Marcel has taken the TV remote again.
Ross Geller says Marcel should give Ross Geller the TV remote right now.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller should relax.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller will fix the TV.
Rachel Green says the character Urkel's name in Spanish is 'Urkel'.
Ross Geller says Marcel changed the TV to Spanish and asks how Marcel did it.
Chandler Bing says Monica Geller should tell Chandler Bing something.

Chandler Bing asks whether Monica Geller is leaving the Christmas lights up as part of Monica Geller's plan to keep Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing merry all year long.
Monica Geller says Chandler Bing should understand the explanation about the Christmas lights.
Monica Geller says someone was supposed to take the Christmas lights down around New Year's.
Monica Geller says someone forgot to take the Christmas lights down.
Rachel Green says someone was supposed to write the note 'Rach, take down the lights'.
Rachel Green says someone was supposed to put the note on the refrigerator.
Rachel Green says the note is on the refrigerator.
Chandler Bing asks where Joey Tribbiani has been.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani went back to Riffs.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani thinks Ursula Buffay likes Joey Tribbiani.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani ordered coffee.
Joey Tribbiani says Ursula Buffay brought Joey Tribbiani a tuna melt and four plates of curly fries.
Joey Tribbiani says Ursula Buffay is very hot.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani should listen.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani might do something impulsive.
Chandler Bing says Joey Tribbiani might want to run it by Phoebe Buffay first.
Joey Tribbiani asks Phoebe Buffay if it would be okay for Joey Tribbiani to ask out Phoebe Buffay's sister Ursula Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay asks why Joey Tribbiani would want to ask out Ursula Buffay.
Joey Tribbiani says he and Ursula Buffay would go out on a date.
Joey Tribbiani says that if Joey Tribbiani and Ursula Buffay went out on a date, Ursula Buffay would be there.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay means what she is saying.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is not responsible for her sister Ursula Buffay.
Phoebe Buffay says it is true that Phoebe Buffay and Ursula Buffay were one egg once.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay and Ursula Buffay have grown apart.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay does not know.
Ross Geller asks whether Phoebe Buffay is okay.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay is fine.
Ross Geller asks whether Phoebe Buffay wants to watch Laverne y Shirley.
